timeframe: M15 (decision at the close of the signal bar; bars are the broker BID chart)

B.name: breakout continuation
B.eligibility: close beyond a tight 12-bar box (height <= 3 ATR, mean range <= 0.8 ATR) by a decisive bar (body >= 0.5 range, same colour)
B.opposing_level: nearest unbroken M15 structure level (support for a sell, resistance for a buy)

C.name: reversal after a failed breakout
C.eligibility: sweep of the previous 10 bars' extreme that closes back inside, then a CHoCH or BOS in the same direction within 6 bars; eligible at the confirming bar's close

D.name: range interaction
D.eligibility: RANGE-labelled bar (the control's regime classifier) with a wick rejection whose tip is within 0.25 ATR of the 20-bar boundary
D.opposing_level: the opposite boundary of the 20 bars before the signal

order_contract.entry_quote: BUY at the ask (close + the bar's spread), SELL at the bid (close)
order_contract.stop: core.risk.compute_stop (the control's): invalidation + 0.1 ATR buffer, floored at 1.25 ATR, REFUSED above 3 ATR (MAX_STOP_ATR) or below the broker minimum
order_contract.target: core.risk.compute_targets (the control's): R multiple 2.0 capped by the opposing level with a 0.1 ATR buffer; REFUSED when the room is gone or net R:R < 1.5 (net_rr = (reward - spread) / (risk + spread), the planning gate, not a charge)
order_contract.cost: cost_R = (spread_price + 2 * 3 points slippage) / risk_distance must be <= 0.15 (the C2 screen; a screen, never a deduction)
order_contract.clearance: the opposing level must be at least 1.0 ATR from the entry (the control's room rule)
order_contract.expiry: a signal can be acted on for 3 bars of M15 after it is known
order_contract.episodes: eligibilities of one family and side within 6 bars are ONE episode; only its first bar is a signal
order_contract.overlap: one open position per branch; a signal inside the 96-bar maximum-hold window of an earlier accepted signal of the same branch is flagged OVERLAP (reported, never hidden)
order_contract.risk: 0.25% per trade, the account governor and every PAPER rule of the control apply unchanged when and if a family is ever run in PAPER

ablation.design: cumulative funnel RAW -> EPISODES -> CLEARANCE -> STOP -> TARGET -> COST -> (no overlap), plus the first refusing gate of every episode
to_run_after_owner_approval: B: A + clearance + stop + target gates
D: C + the account governor and PAPER rules
each step reports what is lost, never selects the best step by result

research_budget.k: per family (see hypothesis_ledger.json); a variant would raise K and the bootstrap bar

outcomes: NOT OPENED. A later confirmation on VALIDATION' needs the owner's approval after the Stage A review.
